001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.json;
002
003import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonFactory;
004import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator;
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser;
006import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonToken;
007import com.streamconverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
008import com.streamconverter.path.IPath;
009import java.io.IOException;
010import java.io.InputStream;
011import java.io.OutputStream;
012import java.util.ArrayList;
013import java.util.List;
014
015/**
016 * JSON Filter Command Class
017 *
018 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from JSON using TreePath expressions. Unlike
019 * JsonNavigateCommand which applies transformations, JsonFilterCommand only extracts/filters data
020 * based on specified paths without any modifications.
021 *
022 * <p>Features: - Extract specific elements using TreePath expressions - Preserve exact data types
023 * and structure of extracted elements - Streaming processing via Jackson Streaming API
024 * (JsonParser/JsonGenerator); the document is never fully loaded into memory - Support for simple
025 * path expressions including wildcards ($[*].field, $.array[*].nested.field)
026 */
027public class JsonFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
028
029  private final IPath<List<String>> jsonPath;
030  private final JsonFactory jsonFactory;
031
032  /**
033   * Constructor for JSON filtering with typed TreePath selector.
034   *
035   * @param jsonPath the typed TreePath to extract data
036   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null
037   */
038  private JsonFilterCommand(IPath<List<String>> jsonPath) {
039    this.jsonPath = jsonPath;
040    this.jsonFactory = new JsonFactory();
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Factory method for JSON filtering with typed path selector.
045   *
046   * @param jsonPath the typed path to extract data
047   * @return a JsonFilterCommand instance
048   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null
049   */
050  public static JsonFilterCommand create(IPath<List<String>> jsonPath) {
051    if (jsonPath == null) {
052      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
053    }
054    return new JsonFilterCommand(jsonPath);
055  }
056
057  @Override
058  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
059    String path = jsonPath.toString();
060    List<PathSegment> segments = parsePath(path);
061
062    try (JsonParser parser = jsonFactory.createParser(inputStream);
063        JsonGenerator generator = jsonFactory.createGenerator(outputStream)) {
064      generator.disable(JsonGenerator.Feature.AUTO_CLOSE_TARGET);
065
066      if (segments.isEmpty()) {
067        // Root path "$": copy the entire document
068        copyValue(parser, generator);
069      } else {
070        extractPath(parser, generator, segments, 0);
071      }
072
073      generator.flush();
074    }
075  }
076
077  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
078  // Path parsing
079  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
080
081  /** A single segment in a parsed path. */
082  private static class PathSegment {
083
084    final String fieldName; // non-null for field access
085    final boolean isWildcard; // true for [*]
086    final int arrayIndex; // >= 0 for numeric index, -1 otherwise
087
088    static PathSegment field(String name) {
089      return new PathSegment(name, false, -1);
090    }
091
092    static PathSegment wildcard() {
093      return new PathSegment(null, true, -1);
094    }
095
096    static PathSegment index(int i) {
097      return new PathSegment(null, false, i);
098    }
099
100    private PathSegment(String fieldName, boolean isWildcard, int arrayIndex) {
101      this.fieldName = fieldName;
102      this.isWildcard = isWildcard;
103      this.arrayIndex = arrayIndex;
104    }
105
106    boolean isField() {
107      return fieldName != null;
108    }
109  }
110
111  /**
112   * Parse a path string into an ordered list of {@link PathSegment}s.
113   *
114   * <p>Supported syntax:
115   *
116   * <ul>
117   *   <li>{@code $} – root (empty list)
118   *   <li>{@code $.name} – top-level field
119   *   <li>{@code $[*].name} – root-array wildcard then field
120   *   <li>{@code $.users[*].profile.department} – field, wildcard, nested fields
121   * </ul>
122   *
123   * @param path the path expression
124   * @return ordered list of path segments (empty = root)
125   */
126  private static List<PathSegment> parsePath(String path) {
127    List<PathSegment> result = new ArrayList<>();
128    if ("$".equals(path)) {
129      return result;
130    }
131
132    // Strip leading "$" then process the remaining characters
133    int start = path.startsWith("$") ? 1 : 0;
134    String rest = path.substring(start);
135
136    int i = 0;
137    while (i < rest.length()) {
138      char c = rest.charAt(i);
139      if (c == '.') {
140        i++; // skip dot separator
141      } else if (c == '[') {
142        // Array access: [*] or [N]
143        int close = rest.indexOf(']', i);
144        if (close == -1) {
145          break; // malformed – stop here
146        }
147        String inner = rest.substring(i + 1, close);
148        if ("*".equals(inner)) {
149          result.add(PathSegment.wildcard());
150        } else {
151          try {
152            result.add(PathSegment.index(Integer.parseInt(inner)));
153          } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
154            result.add(PathSegment.wildcard()); // treat unknown as wildcard
155          }
156        }
157        i = close + 1;
158      } else {
159        // Field name: read until '.', '[', or end
160        int end = i;
161        while (end < rest.length() && rest.charAt(end) != '.' && rest.charAt(end) != '[') {
162          end++;
163        }
164        String fieldName = rest.substring(i, end);
165        if (!fieldName.isEmpty()) {
166          result.add(PathSegment.field(fieldName));
167        }
168        i = end;
169      }
170    }
171    return result;
172  }
173
174  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
175  // Streaming extraction
176  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
177
178  /**
179   * Advance the parser to the next value and recursively navigate {@code segments[segIdx..]} to
180   * write the matching value(s) to {@code generator}.
181   *
182   * @param parser the JSON parser (not yet advanced to the target value)
183   * @param generator the JSON generator
184   * @param segments the full path segment list
185   * @param segIdx current position in {@code segments}
186   */
187  private void extractPath(
188      JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator, List<PathSegment> segments, int segIdx)
189      throws IOException {
190
191    if (segIdx >= segments.size()) {
192      copyValue(parser, generator);
193      return;
194    }
195
196    PathSegment seg = segments.get(segIdx);
197    JsonToken token = parser.nextToken();
198
199    if (token == null) {
200      generator.writeNull();
201      return;
202    }
203
204    if (seg.isField()) {
205      // Expect an object; find the named field
206      if (token != JsonToken.START_OBJECT) {
207        skipValue(parser, token);
208        generator.writeNull();
209        return;
210      }
211      boolean found = false;
212      JsonToken t;
213      // Scan object fields until the current object closes or the stream ends unexpectedly.
214      while ((t = parser.nextToken()) != null && t != JsonToken.END_OBJECT) {
215        String name = parser.currentName();
216        if (seg.fieldName.equals(name)) {
217          extractPath(parser, generator, segments, segIdx + 1);
218          found = true;
219        } else {
220          parser.nextToken();
221          skipValue(parser, parser.currentToken());
222        }
223      }
224      if (!found) {
225        generator.writeNull();
226      }
227    } else if (seg.isWildcard) {
228      // Expect an array; iterate elements and extract from each
229      if (token != JsonToken.START_ARRAY) {
230        skipValue(parser, token);
231        generator.writeNull();
232        return;
233      }
234      generator.writeStartArray();
235      JsonToken elemToken;
236      // Stream array elements until the current array closes or the stream ends unexpectedly.
237      while ((elemToken = parser.nextToken()) != null && elemToken != JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
238        if (segIdx + 1 >= segments.size()) {
239          copyValue(parser, generator, elemToken);
240        } else {
241          extractFromToken(parser, generator, segments, segIdx + 1, elemToken);
242        }
243      }
244      generator.writeEndArray();
245    } else {
246      // Numeric index access
247      if (token != JsonToken.START_ARRAY) {
248        skipValue(parser, token);
249        generator.writeNull();
250        return;
251      }
252      int currentIdx = 0;
253      boolean found = false;
254      JsonToken arrToken;
255      // Walk array elements until the target index is found or the array closes.
256      while ((arrToken = parser.nextToken()) != null && arrToken != JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
257        if (currentIdx == seg.arrayIndex) {
258          extractPath(parser, generator, segments, segIdx + 1);
259          found = true;
260          JsonToken skipToken;
261          // Skip the remaining elements so the parser is positioned after the current array.
262          while ((skipToken = parser.nextToken()) != null && skipToken != JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
263            skipValue(parser, skipToken);
264          }
265          break;
266        } else {
267          skipValue(parser, arrToken);
268        }
269        currentIdx++;
270      }
271      if (!found) {
272        generator.writeNull();
273      }
274    }
275  }
276
277  /**
278   * Same as {@link #extractPath} but the parser's current token has already been consumed and is
279   * supplied as {@code currentToken}. Used when iterating array elements where {@code nextToken()}
280   * was already called to detect {@code END_ARRAY}.
281   */
282  private void extractFromToken(
283      JsonParser parser,
284      JsonGenerator generator,
285      List<PathSegment> segments,
286      int segIdx,
287      JsonToken currentToken)
288      throws IOException {
289
290    if (segIdx >= segments.size()) {
291      copyValue(parser, generator, currentToken);
292      return;
293    }
294
295    PathSegment seg = segments.get(segIdx);
296
297    if (seg.isField()) {
298      if (currentToken != JsonToken.START_OBJECT) {
299        skipValue(parser, currentToken);
300        generator.writeNull();
301        return;
302      }
303      boolean found = false;
304      JsonToken t2;
305      // Scan object fields until the current object closes or the stream ends unexpectedly.
306      while ((t2 = parser.nextToken()) != null && t2 != JsonToken.END_OBJECT) {
307        String name = parser.currentName();
308        if (seg.fieldName.equals(name)) {
309          extractPath(parser, generator, segments, segIdx + 1);
310          found = true;
311        } else {
312          parser.nextToken();
313          skipValue(parser, parser.currentToken());
314        }
315      }
316      if (!found) {
317        generator.writeNull();
318      }
319    } else if (seg.isWildcard) {
320      if (currentToken != JsonToken.START_ARRAY) {
321        skipValue(parser, currentToken);
322        generator.writeNull();
323        return;
324      }
325      generator.writeStartArray();
326      JsonToken elemToken2;
327      // Stream array elements until the current array closes or the stream ends unexpectedly.
328      while ((elemToken2 = parser.nextToken()) != null && elemToken2 != JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
329        if (segIdx + 1 >= segments.size()) {
330          copyValue(parser, generator, elemToken2);
331        } else {
332          extractFromToken(parser, generator, segments, segIdx + 1, elemToken2);
333        }
334      }
335      generator.writeEndArray();
336    } else {
337      if (currentToken != JsonToken.START_ARRAY) {
338        skipValue(parser, currentToken);
339        generator.writeNull();
340        return;
341      }
342      int currentIdx = 0;
343      boolean found = false;
344      JsonToken arrToken2;
345      // Walk array elements until the target index is found or the array closes.
346      while ((arrToken2 = parser.nextToken()) != null && arrToken2 != JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
347        if (currentIdx == seg.arrayIndex) {
348          extractPath(parser, generator, segments, segIdx + 1);
349          found = true;
350          JsonToken skipToken2;
351          // Skip the remaining elements so the parser is positioned after the current array.
352          while ((skipToken2 = parser.nextToken()) != null && skipToken2 != JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
353            skipValue(parser, skipToken2);
354          }
355          break;
356        } else {
357          skipValue(parser, arrToken2);
358        }
359        currentIdx++;
360      }
361      if (!found) {
362        generator.writeNull();
363      }
364    }
365  }
366
367  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
368  // Copy / skip helpers
369  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
370
371  /**
372   * Copy the next complete value from {@code parser} to {@code generator}. Advances the parser by
373   * one token internally.
374   */
375  private void copyValue(JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator) throws IOException {
376    JsonToken token = parser.nextToken();
377    if (token == null) {
378      generator.writeNull();
379      return;
380    }
381    copyValue(parser, generator, token);
382  }
383
384  /**
385   * Copy a complete value starting at {@code token} (already read) from {@code parser} to {@code
386   * generator}.
387   */
388  private void copyValue(JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator, JsonToken token)
389      throws IOException {
390    switch (token) {
391      case START_OBJECT:
392        generator.writeStartObject();
393        JsonToken objToken;
394        // Copy fields until the current object closes or the stream ends unexpectedly.
395        while ((objToken = parser.nextToken()) != null && objToken != JsonToken.END_OBJECT) {
396          generator.writeFieldName(parser.currentName());
397          copyValue(parser, generator);
398        }
399        generator.writeEndObject();
400        break;
401
402      case START_ARRAY:
403        generator.writeStartArray();
404        JsonToken t;
405        // Copy elements until the current array closes or the stream ends unexpectedly.
406        while ((t = parser.nextToken()) != null && t != JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
407          copyValue(parser, generator, t);
408        }
409        generator.writeEndArray();
410        break;
411
412      case VALUE_STRING:
413        generator.writeString(parser.getText());
414        break;
415
416      case VALUE_NUMBER_INT:
417        generator.writeNumber(parser.getLongValue());
418        break;
419
420      case VALUE_NUMBER_FLOAT:
421        generator.writeNumber(parser.getDoubleValue());
422        break;
423
424      case VALUE_TRUE:
425        generator.writeBoolean(true);
426        break;
427
428      case VALUE_FALSE:
429        generator.writeBoolean(false);
430        break;
431
432      default:
433        generator.writeNull();
434        break;
435    }
436  }
437
438  /**
439   * Skip over a complete value starting at {@code token} (already read). Does not write anything.
440   */
441  private void skipValue(JsonParser parser, JsonToken token) throws IOException {
442    if (token == null) {
443      return;
444    }
445    switch (token) {
446      case START_OBJECT:
447        int objDepth = 1;
448        while (objDepth > 0) {
449          JsonToken t = parser.nextToken();
450          if (t == JsonToken.START_OBJECT) {
451            objDepth++;
452          } else if (t == JsonToken.END_OBJECT) {
453            objDepth--;
454          }
455        }
456        break;
457
458      case START_ARRAY:
459        int arrDepth = 1;
460        while (arrDepth > 0) {
461          JsonToken t = parser.nextToken();
462          if (t == JsonToken.START_ARRAY) {
463            arrDepth++;
464          } else if (t == JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
465            arrDepth--;
466          }
467        }
468        break;
469
470      default:
471        // Scalar values are self-contained – nothing more to skip
472        break;
473    }
474  }
475}
